title: A Message from Anna
text:
Hi Tom, thanks for your email. I am sorry I did not write back sooner. This week was very busy for me at work. I hope you are well and your family is good too.

Next Saturday, I want to visit you in Lisbon. Can we meet at the park near your house? We can have lunch together after our walk. Please write back and tell me if the day is good for you. See you soon, Anna.

questions.text: Why did Anna not write back sooner?
options: She was very busy at work.

questions.text: What does Anna want to do next Saturday?
How does Anna feel about Tom?
options: She is friendly and wants to see him
She does not want to meet him

questions.text: What kind of message is this?

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of work or things to do
to go to see a person or a place
a public green area for walking and play
a trip made on foot for pleasure or exercise

paragraph_translations: Oi, Tom, agradeço pelo seu e-mail. Sinto muito por não ter respondido antes. Esta semana foi muito corrida para mim no trabalho. Espero que você esteja bem e que sua família também esteja.

No próximo sábado, quero visitar você em Lisboa. Podemos nos encontrar no parque perto da sua casa? Podemos almoçar juntos depois do nosso passeio. Por favor, responda e me diga se o dia é bom para você. Até breve, Anna.
